correctness.rationale: For rank k the vertex coordinate multiset is n,...,n-k+1 and zeros. Opposite-rank pairwise distance is bounded below by n-k using the rearrangement inequality for rank k<ell; changed-support equal-rank distance is at least sqrt(2)*(n-k+1). At scale 1 exactly the rank-n to rank-(n-1) deletion pairs arise if n<=m. At scale sqrt(2) successive label swaps connect fixed-support permutation classes, and when n<=m swaps of 1 and zero connect top-rank supports. Every remaining rank-k support class first joins the already connected higher-rank core at integer radius n-k via adjoining its next label, and the pairwise inequalities exclude any earlier shortcut through any other rank or nonedge. Counts of components give the exact all-parameter barcode and Kruskal spectrum. The standalone integer-arithmetic checker independently validated 55 parameter profiles and 59,105 complete-graph Euclidean pairs; checks are finite corroboration only.

value.rationale: An exact complete degree-zero Euclidean persistence barcode is a canonical metric invariant of an infinite family of polytopal vertex clouds. The result replaces factorially many points and quadratic pair comparisons with O(min(m,n)) support-rank multiplicity formulas, distinguishes all parameter regimes including the onset of distance-one mergers at n=m, proves an exact optimal MST length and its connectivity radius, and nontrivially excludes arbitrary short nonedge shortcuts. This goes beyond merely tabulating known skeleton lengths or restating vertices and facets.
